## Getting Started

### Download and install GRASS

### Create Python Virtual Environment

```bash
python3 -m venv .venv
```

### Activate Python Virtual Environment

```bash
source .venv/bin/activate
```

### Install Python Dependencies

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt

```

### Setup GRASS Projects

Now create a new GRASS project for each of the study areas. The meta data for each site is located at
[site-CRS-info.txt](../site-CRS-info.txt).

```plain
# file: site-CRS-info.txt
clay-center:32614:3:2021:39.4003765:-97.0630433:Kansas
coweeta:26917:10:2022:35.0467816:-83.4497516:North Carolina
SFREC:26910:1:2022:39.2731237:-121.3103158:California
SJER:26911:1:2022:37.0949164:-119.7447120:California
tx069-playas:32613:8:2022:34.4884740:-102.1068130:Texas
```


```bash
$ python python3 scripts/download_data.py
```
